A natural collaborator who enjoys meeting people and hearing new ideas. You listen with empathy and build trust across teams and partners. Exceptional organization across multiple projects, substantial budgets, and tight deadlines, with the flexibility to reprioritize when plans change. High standards for quality and a willingness to get hands-on. You bring a sense of humor and don’t take yourself too seriously.
